title: Stanford bunny (rendered)
author: Marcel Padilla
attribution: Derived from the Stanford Bunny STL by Makerbot (Wikimedia Commons), CC BY 3.0.

pipeline.render: Blender 5.1 Cycles, 160 views at 800px, 128 samples, transparent film, exact known poses written as a NeRF transforms.json
pipeline.training: Brush from source, 30k iterations, 500k cap, --alpha-mode transparent, NO COLMAP (the poses are exact, so structure-from-motion is skipped)
pipeline.surface: matte off-white with a micro-bump normal, the renderer's default 'matte' style

revision.change: Re-rendered from the same CC BY 3.0 STL with the matte surface instead of the previous high-frequency multi-colour Voronoi texture. The rainbow was there to give the photometric trainer something to lock onto, and it worked, but it made the object read as an abstract test pattern rather than the Stanford bunny. The matte surface trains at least as well: PSNR 43.23 against 42.66 for the rainbow, SSIM unchanged at 0.9964.
